en:
<CLT=cltMIND>I know we're supposed to be searching for
the <CLT=cltSTRONG>secret of the outside world<CLT=cltMIND>...

<CLT=cltMIND>But what *is* it? An object?
Something else entirely?

I suppose I should search everywhere,
look for anything suspicious...

<CLT=cltMIND>I searched every nook and cranny in
the kitchen, but...

*sigh*... I looked everywhere, but I
didn't find anything suspicious...

Perhaps I missed something...
I'll look one more time.
<CLT=cltMIND>But it was a waste of time—I found nothing.
It's been a while, but I can't find anything.

<CLT=cltMIND>If I haven't found anything even after
all of this, it can't be in the kitchen.

<CLT=cltMIND>What should I do now...?
Search somewhere else?
How'd your search go, Shuichi?
I didn't find anything...how about you?

The same... I checked every corner, 
but I didn't find a thing.

I'm starting to wonder if there's even something
actually hidden here. Was Monokuma just lying?

<CLT=cltMIND>The way Monokuma was talking
certainly was suspicious.

Well, Monokuma? Did you prepare some
sort of bait for us?
Oh, bait? Yeah, of course I have.

Puhuhu, is your curiosity piqued?
Then you have no choice but to go.
Yeah! We wanna know, so we'll definitely go!

<CLT=cltMIND>It was Kokichi who was
steering that conversation...
<CLT=cltMIND>But why would he do that?

Oh, by the way... There's something 
that's been bothering me...
Hm? Something bothering you?

Y-Yeah... It might have just been 
my imagination, but...

There's a small window in the dining room...
Maybe ten minutes ago, I looked through it...
And I thought I saw Miu.

You saw Miu?
But she should be in the chapel...

And...the bridge fell, so she shouldn't 
be able to get over here, right?

That's why I thought it was just my imagination,
but I figured I should say something—
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>BANG!!!
Ah!?
Wh-What!? What was that sound!?

It sounded as if something was struck
very hard. It came from outside, but...
Tsumugi! Let's go look!
Y-Yeah!

Wh-What was that sound!?
Shouldn't we go see what it was?
